Name: Huckleberry Season for Content Patcher
Author: MarsCBG
Description:
Huckleberries are back, this time with Content Patcher.

This is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15812]Huckleberry Season[/url] to Content Patcher with the permission of the original mod creator fwippy.

From the original mod's description:
[quote]"These delicious berries spawn anywhere you can find wild berry bushes.  They're slightly more nutritious than salmonberries and blackberries, but you'll only find them from Summer 12 to 16.

This mod only adds huckleberries; it doesn't add any additional recipes or artisan goods.  However, mod makers should feel free to use these huckleberries in recipes, artisan goods, gift tastes for an NPC [i]that you created[/i], anything!  All I ask is that huckleberries be kept as wild forage and not made into a growable crop.  Other than that, I'm excited to see what you cook up![/quote]
New in this version, choose how much energy and health the berries give, plus two options for NPC gifting:
[list]
[*]Balanced: Gift tastes are closer to vanilla opinions on foraged berries, nobody loves or hates them either way.
[*]Original: The gift tastes from the original mod, certain people love huckleberries and others could do without.
[/list]
Includes a French translation.

Optional:
Has an optional download for Portrait Frame Variations. To use copy the contents of the extra file to the [CP] PortraitFrameVariations folder in Portrait Frame Variations.
